ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The point $P$ is a point on the line segment $AB$, and the points $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of the line segments $AP$ and $PB$, respectively. As shown in the figure, if the point $P$ is the midpoint of the line segment $AB$, and $MP=4\, \text{cm}$, what is the length of the line segment $AB$ in cm?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that point $M$ and $N$ are the midpoints of line segments $AP$ and $PB$ respectively,\\
$\therefore AP=2MP$, $BP=2PN$.\\
$\because MP=4\, \text{cm}$, $\therefore AP=8\, \text{cm}$.\\
$\because P$ is the midpoint of $AB$, $\therefore AB=2AP=\boxed{16}\, \text{cm}$.
